facts.fact: Finance SAO reports that by a BCEAO communiqué of 25 June 2026 banks, e-money institutions and payment institutions in the UEMOA, Guinea-Bissau included (5 institutions authorised on PI-SPI at 31 July 2026), must connect to PI-SPI by 30 September 2026, and microfinance institutions by 30 June 2027.
facts.system: BCEAO deadline to connect to PI-SPI

systems.system: PI-SPI (Plateforme interopérable du Système de paiement instantané)
systems.tiers: banks, e-money institutions, payment institutions, microfinance institutions
